entities.summary: Aday Mara Gómez is a Spanish college basketball player for the Michigan Wolverines of the Big Ten Conference. He previously played for Basket Zaragoza and the UCLA Bruins. Mara was the Big Ten Defensive Player of the Year in 2026.
